links.text: 01 Airborne & Ground Geophysics Airborne and ground surveys covering magnetic, radiometric, gravity and electrical methods. Over 70 projects and 500,000 line km completed across Mongolia and Asia.

02 Geospatial Solutions Aerial survey, photogrammetry and digital twin solutions built on Bentley's iTwin platform. From orthophotos and terrain models to live asset models that update with each drone pass.
03 Aviation Services Cessna Grand Caravan charters for cargo, medevac, tourism and remote-site logistics, with field aerodrome operations and full in-house aircraft maintenance across Mongolia.

Aviation · 2025 GEOSAN awarded Tavan Tolgoi Airport management contract GEOSAN has been contracted to manage full airport operations at Tavan Tolgoi, covering airside, ground handling, terminal and aeronavigation services. Learn more

Geophysics · 2024 New airborne instruments deployed in Tamil Nadu, India GEOSAN's G-822A magnetometer and RSX-5 spectrometer completed their first international deployment, conducting surveys over Tamil Nadu with our own crew and aircraft. Learn more

Maintenance · 2024 MCAA Part 145 MRO licence renewed and expanded Our maintenance organisation approval has been renewed by the Mongolian Civil Aviation Authority, confirming our authorisation for scheduled and unscheduled work on third-party aircraft. Learn more

Fleet · 2024 Two Airbus H145 helicopters join the GEOSAN fleet GEOSAN has taken delivery of two Airbus H145 twin-engine helicopters, extending our operational reach to terrain inaccessible by fixed-wing aircraft. Learn more

Mapping · 2024 45% of Mongolia mapped at 1:20 000 scale GEOSAN's national mapping programme has now covered nearly half of Mongolia's territory, delivering survey-grade orthophotos and topographic maps to government and industry clients. Learn more

Training · Coming soon GEOSAN Aviation Training Organisation (ATO) in development We are developing an MCAA-approved ATO to deliver type ratings, recurrent training and ground school programmes to aviation professionals across Mongolia. Learn more
